bootstrap_note: 10th–90th percentile across 200 year-stratified training resamples; sensitivity only, not a confidence or prediction interval.

benchmark.methodology: Chronological replay: each IPO is scored by a model trained on earlier listing years.

benchmark.gmp_note: GMP is excluded because historical point-in-time observations are not verified.
